verdict.rationale: Identity endpoints sit under Stripe's dated API versioning. New versions ship monthly with no breaking changes, major releases come twice a year, and requests can be pinned with the Stripe-Version header, backed by an upgrade guide and dated changelog. That covers the versioning half of the story well, but the evidence never states a deprecation or sunset policy. missing for 10: an explicit documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines for old versions, Identity-specific versioning notes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: we release new API versions monthly with no breaking changes. Twice a year, we issue a new major release
